answer: The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in ocean, expire in atlas, and meadow lists each expiry. An adversary running 136 aliases thus needs 75 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3874 identities would post 4483 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
